newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Verbund says H1 group pre-tax, net up.
newsitem.headline: Verbund says H1 group pre-tax, net up.

text.p: Austrian national utility Verbund said on Wednesday group first half net profit and pre-tax profit rose but noted it would have to work hard to match 1995's full-year net profit figure.

In a statement released ahead of a news conference, Oesterreichische Elektrizitaetswirtschafts AG (Verbund) said group pre-tax profit rose to 864 million schillings from 639 million. Net profit increased to 765.6 million from 539.8.

"Last year we achieved an excellent net profit and this year, given the below average water levels (in rivers) in the first six months, it will require some effort to match that good figure," Verbund said.
Verbund reported a group net profit of 1.381 billion schillings for 1995.
The utility said net profit and pre-tax profit in the first six months had received a boost from higher sales, lower personnel costs and a reduced financial loss.
Group earnings before interest and tax declined to 1.581 billion schillings from 1.981 billion, however, due to higher fuel expenses and electricity purchase costs.
"These increases were only partly offset by lower personnel expenses and reduced other expenses," Verbund said.

Sales jumped to 10.397 billion schillings from 9.52 billion. The group's financial loss narrowed to 716.8 million schillings from 1.342 billion last year, helped by foreign currency gains and lower interest rates.
Personnel costs sank to 2.863 billion schillings from 2.919 billion.
